mapper.select: -- category SELECT DISTINCT '' AS "objId", obj."data" ->> 'category' AS label, obj."data" ->> 'category' AS ID, obj."data" ->> 'category' AS "parentId", 'category' AS "level" FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" IN ( SELECT jsonb_object_keys ( obj."data" -> '__closure' ) FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" = ( SELECT info -> 'commit' ->> 'objectId' AS objectId FROM stream_activity WHERE "resourceId" = #{resourceId} AND "actionType" = 'commit_create' ) ) AND obj."data" ->> 'category' IS NOT NULL -- AND obj."data" ->> 'family' IS NOT NULL -- AND obj."data" ->> 'type' IS NOT NULL UNION ALL -- family SELECT DISTINCT '' AS "objId", obj."data" ->> 'family' AS label, concat(obj."data" ->> 'family', '|', obj."data" ->> 'category') AS ID, obj."data" ->> 'category' AS "parentId", 'family' AS "level" FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" IN ( SELECT jsonb_object_keys ( obj."data" -> '__closure' ) FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" = ( SELECT info -> 'commit' ->> 'objectId' AS objectId FROM stream_activity WHERE "resourceId" = #{resourceId} AND "actionType" = 'commit_create' ) ) AND obj."data" ->> 'category' IS NOT NULL AND obj."data" ->> 'family' IS NOT NULL UNION ALL -- type SELECT DISTINCT '' AS "objId", obj."data" ->> 'type' AS label, concat(obj."data" ->> 'category', '|', obj."data" ->> 'family','|',obj."data" ->> 'type') AS ID, concat(obj."data" ->> 'family', '|', obj."data" ->> 'category') AS "parentId", 'type' AS "level" FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" IN ( SELECT jsonb_object_keys ( obj."data" -> '__closure' ) FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" = ( SELECT info -> 'commit' ->> 'objectId' AS objectId FROM stream_activity WHERE "resourceId" = #{resourceId} AND "actionType" = 'commit_create' ) ) AND obj."data" ->> 'family' IS NOT NULL AND obj."data" ->> 'type' IS NOT NULL UNION ALL -- elementId SELECT DISTINCT obj."id" AS "objId", -- obj."data" ->> 'elementId' AS label, obj."id" AS "label", concat(obj."data" ->> 'category', '|', obj."data" ->> 'family','|',obj."data" ->> 'type','|',obj."id") AS ID, concat(obj."data" ->> 'category', '|', obj."data" ->> 'family','|',obj."data" ->> 'type') AS parentId, 'elementId' AS "level" FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" IN ( SELECT jsonb_object_keys ( obj."data" -> '__closure' ) FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" = ( SELECT info -> 'commit' ->> 'objectId' AS objectId FROM stream_activity WHERE "resourceId" = #{resourceId} AND "actionType" = 'commit_create') ) AND obj."data" ->> 'elementId' IS NOT NULL AND obj."data" ->> 'type' IS NOT NULL

SELECT obj."id" AS objId, obj."data" ->> 'speckle_type' AS speckle_type, obj."data" ->'definition'->>'referencedId' AS referencedId, obj."data" ->> 'category' AS category, -- obj."data" ->> 'family' AS family, COALESCE(obj."data" ->> 'family', obj."data" ->> 'category' || '-family') AS family , obj."data" ->> 'type' AS "type", obj."data" ->> 'elementId' AS "elementId" FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" IN ( SELECT jsonb_object_keys ( obj."data" -> '__closure' ) FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" = ( SELECT info -> 'commit' ->> 'objectId' AS objectId FROM stream_activity WHERE "resourceId" = #{resourceId} AND "actionType" = 'commit_create') ) AND obj."streamId" = #{streamId}
